ctx.x: I didn't get to see Goldkett, but I've heard him on the radio, and then I -- that was at the Oriental Theater was a fellow by the name of Victor Young who later went to, went on to Hollywood to, to be an orchestra leader there. And he was at the Oriental Theater then, and I used to go hear him all the time.
Do you recall hearing Kid Ory on any recordings or broadcast, either when you were in Chicago or when you went to California?

No, I didn't hear anything about Kid Ory. Everything was Armstrong, Armstrong. And then at one time, I heard of King Oliver, and also. But I didn't a, I didn't get the chance to. I think Ory was in a, in California. He always -- when he left New Orleans, I think he went straight
